Add missing Amiga FFI structs and fix struct ordering issues

## Problem
struct_array_test was failing with 41 errors about missing FFI types:
- 18 "unknown type" errors for missing structs
- 4 forward reference errors from incorrect ordering  
- Undefined constant errors in array size declarations

## Solution

### Added 14 Missing Struct Definitions
1. Rectangle - Graphics rectangle (MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY)
2. BitMap - Bitmap structure for graphics data
3. RastPort - Graphics rendering port
4. Layer - Graphics layer management
5. Hook - Utility callback hook structure
6. SignalSemaphore - Exec semaphore for synchronization
7. IBox - Intuition bounding box
8. DrawInfo - Screen drawing information
9. Screen - Intuition screen structure
10. Window - Intuition window structure
11. Requester - Intuition requester structure
12. Gadget - Intuition gadget structure
13. NewWindow - Window initialization structure
14. GadgetInfo - Gadget rendering information

### Fixed Struct Ordering (Forward References)
Moved 4 structs to be defined before use:
- WBArg: line 1524 → 951 (before AppMessage)
- RootNode: line 1140 → 1127 (before DosLibrary)
- AChain: line 1275 → 1263 (before AnchorPath)
- NotifyRequest: line 1300 → 1291 (before NotifyMessage)

### Fixed Constant References
Replaced symbolic constants with literal values in array sizes:
- GLOBALSZ → 200
- RXBUFFSZ → 204
- MAXFONTPATH → 256
- MAXFONTNAME → 32
- MAXFONTPATH-2 → 254

This prevents module loading conflicts when importing both
amiga_structs and amiga_consts.

### Added Missing Constant
- GLOBALSZ to amiga_consts.novus (value: 200)

✅ Test suite: 964/964 tests pass (100% pass rate)
✅ struct_array_test now compiles successfully
✅ All FFI type dependencies resolved

Add AmigaOS shared library project template

## Overview
Created a comprehensive "Hello World" template for AmigaOS shared libraries
(.library files) following the "rails new" pattern - just enough code to
demonstrate the framework, compile, and run right out of the gate.

## Template Structure (7 files, 1000+ lines of documentation)

**Configuration:**
- novus.toml - Library project configuration
- examples/novus.toml - Test program configuration

**Novus Implementation (400+ lines):**
- src/lib.novus - Main library code with extensive documentation
  - ExampleLibraryBase struct (Library header + custom fields)
  - LibOpen/LibClose/LibExpunge/LibReserved lifecycle functions
  - GetVersion() and Multiply() example functions
  - Every function documented with WHEN CALLED, PARAMETERS, RETURNS,
    LIFECYCLE, VECTOR OFFSET, EXAMPLE FLOW

**Assembly Glue Code:**
- src/library_base.s - ROMTag and AutoInit structures (150+ lines)
  - ROMTag with magic word 0x4AFC for exec.library scanning
  - AutoInit structure for MakeLibrary
  - Function vector table (negative offsets from library base)
  - InitTable for library header initialization

- src/wrappers.s - A6 calling convention translation (100+ lines)
  - Wrappers for each library function
  - Translate AmigaOS (A6/registers) ↔ C (stack) calling conventions
  - Register preservation (D2-D7, A2-A6)

**Test Program:**
- examples/test_example.novus - Working test demonstrating library usage
  - Opens library with OpenLibrary()
  - Calls library functions (currently placeholder)
  - Closes library with CloseLibrary()

**Documentation:**
- README.md - Comprehensive 350+ line guide covering:
  - Three-layer architecture (Novus/Translation/Bootstrap)
  - Library lifecycle (LOAD → INIT → READY → OPEN → IN USE → CLOSE → EXPUNGE)
  - Step-by-step guide for adding new functions
  - Memory layout diagrams
  - Calling convention details
  - Common pitfalls and troubleshooting
  - Links to AmigaOS developer documentation

## Missing Novus Features Identified

This template currently requires assembly glue code due to missing language features:
- @resident attribute - Would auto-generate ROMTag
- @libvec attribute - Would auto-generate function vector tables
- @autoinit attribute - Would auto-generate AutoInit structure
- Register calling conventions - Currently requires manual wrappers
- Inline asm {} blocks - Mentioned in docs but not yet functional

When these features are implemented, library creation will simplify to:

```novus
@resident(name="example.library", version=1)
@autoinit

@libvec(-30)
pub fn GetVersion(base: *ExampleLibraryBase) -> u32 {
    return 0x00010000
}
```

## Build Instructions

The template includes complete build instructions:
1. Compile Novus code: novusc build
2. Assemble glue code: vasmm68k_mot -Fhunk -o build/library_base.o src/library_base.s
3. Assemble wrappers: vasmm68k_mot -Fhunk -o build/wrappers.o src/wrappers.s
4. Link: vlink -bamigahunk -o build/example.library ...
5. Install: Copy to LIBS: directory
6. Test: Build and run examples/test_example.novus

## Fixes
- Fixed .gitignore to allow templates/ directory (changed test_* to /test_*)
- Fixed .gitignore to only ignore generated test configs (changed path to absolute)

## Design Philosophy
This template follows the "rails new" pattern requested for all Novus project types:
- Immediately runnable out of the gate
- Demonstrates minimal working functionality
- Extensively documented with examples
- Shows complete lifecycle and architecture
- Identifies gaps in language features

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
